releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.214: App Share now attaches the original My Diary logo image with the formatted invitation and existing direct APK download link. Existing share chooser, app identity, notes, photos, PINs, locks, widgets, and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 419: Changed both the live time and date text beneath My Notes to the same Pearl White (#FFFFFF). Preserved the existing 3D raised text effect, 12-hour clock with AM/PM and seconds, IST timezone, font sizes, and one-line date. No note data, photos, PINs, locks, or APK source changed.
